{{Quote|Says here, nine years ago, before Jenkes joined the Imperial service, he managed a gladiator arena on the planet Nyriaan.|The bounty hunter [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]] discovers Jenkes' past on Nyriaan|<ref name="EG" />}}
'''Nyriaan''' was a [[planet]] where the [[human]] [[Jenkes]] managed a [[Nyriaan gladiator arena|gladiator arena]] during the early [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Era|rule]]. Nine [[Standard year|years]] after operating the arena, Jenkes, now an [[Imperial officer]] in the [[Imperial Security Bureau]], had two [[gladiator]]s from Nyriaan [[transport]]ed via [[shuttle]] to the planet [[Lothal]]. The two fighters, [[Borbig Drob]] and [[Warjak]], were to participate in [[Gladiator Night]], a new gladiatorial event which Jenkes had set up on Lothal.<ref name="EG" />
